raw_sections.summary:
PROFILE
Finance professional with 4+ years of experience in banking operations, investment operations, fund accounting, transaction management, financial reconciliation, and financial analysis. Experienced in cash and position reconciliation, NAV preparation, trade and cash settlements, corporate actions, cash flow management, portfolio reporting, and financial reporting. Strong experience working with custodian bank accounts, resolving reconciliation breaks, managing financial transactions, and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Goldman Sachs Financial Analyst
Jul 2025 – Jun 2026 Bengaluru, India
Performed daily cash and position reconciliations across multiple custodian accounts and internal systems, ensuring
data accuracy, completeness, and timely resolution of discrepancies.
Investigated and resolved reconciliation breaks across fixed income and equity instruments, ensuring accurate
alignment between internal records and custodian records.
Processed and validated corporate actions, including stock splits, bonus issues, mergers & acquisitions, dividends, and
spin-offs, ensuring accurate portfolio updates and NAV reporting.
Reviewed and validated trade lifecycle records, ensuring consistency between trade date and settlement date across
internal and custodian systems.
Managed FTP data uploads for secure transfer of reconciliation and trade files between internal platforms and custodian
systems, supporting timely processing and data integrity. Executed and managed bulk trade uploads efficiently, ensuring high-volume transactions were processed accurately and within defined timelines.
Performed comprehensive pre-upload validations to identify data discrepancies, completeness issues, and
potential trade errors before submission.
Prepared and validated UI proofs and management fee calculations, and processed initial transfers and account
terminations in accordance with internal controls and client agreements.
Wahed Invest Senior Operations Analyst
Jun 2022 – Feb 2025 Mumbai, India
Managed middle office investment operations and custodian bank accounts, overseeing cash and trade settlements
throughout the full trade lifecycle.
Prepared NAVs for hedge fund clients and issued portfolio statements.
Performed fund accounting, cash/position reconciliation, corporate actions (dividend allocation) and liquidation of
securities and disbursements through SWIFT payments.
Managed end-to-end trade lifecycle by capturing trades from multiple sources, enriching trade data with required reference and settlement details, performing comprehensive validations against business rules and static data, resolving data discrepancies, and coordinating timely trade confirmations to ensure accuracy, completeness, and seamless downstream processing.
Resolved client queries and coordinated with internal/external stakeholders for audit compliance.
Calculated various fees such as safekeeping charges and trading fees.
Conducted reconciliation between broker/counterparty vs. client records for accuracy.
Reported and resolved discrepancies for bank, audit, and cross-functional queries.
Indicia Worldwide
Jun 2021 – May 2022
Transaction Specialist
Mumbai, India
Processed client invoicing - Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable, credit and debit notes, rebills,
intercompany transfers.
Prepared bulk uploads for Accounts Receivable (AR) and fee-related transactions, including validation, and
processing of high-volume financial data while ensuring accurate fee calculations, correct customer/account mapping, data integrity, and timely posting to downstream systems.
Managed cash allocations as per SWIFT payments, revenue reconciliations, and bank reconciliations.
Addressed and provided resolutions to client and supplier queries.
Performed accruals and month-end financial closing activities.
